name: Jose Pierre Adams
notable_stories: Reported by family tradition to be the bastard son of John Quincy Adams, though records indicate Scotland or Virginia birth
He was reportedly accidentally poisoned while testing a variety of herb as a chemist
Immigrated in early manhood (probably the 1810s), settled in Jefferson County, VA
Served as executor of brother-in-law Thomas Hamilton's will in 1836

C-004: RESEARCH FLAG — Jose P. vs Jesse P. name variation. No primary records identified for Jose Pierre Adams. Name may be transcription or naming drift from 'Jesse' to 'Jose'. High-impact uncertainty. Confidence: LOW.
1830 census household: two males 10-15 (likely George and Alexander), one male 40-50 (Jose P.), five girls under 20 and one woman 40-50 (Elizabeth). No census record for him or Elizabeth after 1830.
Per the 1898 biography, he was accidentally poisoned while testing a variety of herb and soon died, aged forty-five.
DPBR: while testing a variety of herb he was accidentally poisoned and soon died, aged forty-five. The author doubts the details but thinks the age may be fairly accurate.
milestones: Settled in Harpers Ferry; worked as a chemist
Served as executor for brother-in-law Thomas Hamilton's will in 1836
Married Elizabeth Eliza Hamilton (1813, Jefferson County, VA)
Census trail: Morgan County VA (1820) → Jefferson County VA (1830)
career: Employed as a chemist in Virginia (per 1898 biography of his grandson)
DPBR: married in Virginia and was employed there as a chemist.
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
Further Research on the Family and Descendants of Joseph P. and Elizabeth (Hamilton) Adams, William W. Allen (February 2012)
Family letters in Bill Allen’s family document
notes: Also identified as Jose1 to distinguish from Jose Pierre Adams (Jose2), his grandson

Child added: adams_george_francis_1. Evidence: Adams direct line: Gen 2 (George Francis Adams #1, b.~1817) is son of Gen 1 (Jose Pierre Adams, b.~1791). Source: adams_direct_line_json_v1, family_data_v1.
C-004: Research flag — possible name transcription error: 'Jose' vs 'Jesse P.' Adams. No primary records confirmed. Should be investigated.

CORRECTION 2026-09-23: Birth changed from "abt 1791" to "abt 1785". The 1820 and 1830 censuses place the birth between 1780 and 1790 (Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012); his 1836 death notice gives his age as about 50. Decision by Brendan Adams.
Parentage unknown [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, 2011, line 3993]

Four further children listed only as unknown1-unknown4 ADAMS, dates unknown [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, 2011, line 4060]

The 1898 biography says he had two sons, George P. [sic] and Alexander Washington, and three daughters; the Hamilton report names only George and Magdalena. [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, 2011, line 4327]
Named in the appraisal of brother-in-law Thomas HAMILTON's estate; as administrator filed the final account in May 1836 [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 9658]
Named Friend and executor in the will of Francis A. HAMILTON, whose aunt Elizabeth he had married [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 9692]

A public record shows John Quincy Adams left him a parcel of land in Missouri. This is the basis of the claimed link to John Quincy Adams. [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, 2011, line 2908]
Reportedly best friends with Francis Hamilton. [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, 2011, line 2911]
